blocks.html: Top-of-Funnel (TOFU) is the earliest stage of the marketing funnel focused on creating awareness and attracting potential prospects through educational and informational content.

TOFU activities are designed to introduce a brand, solve early-stage problems, and generate interest among audiences who may not yet be ready to buy. It is where first impressions and demand generation begin.

items.html: Blog articles and thought leadership content

blocks.html: The goal is to attract traffic, capture attention, and generate leads for later nurturing.
A cybersecurity company publishes beginner guides on ransomware prevention to attract prospects searching for security advice online.
Top-of-Funnel (TOFU) is the awareness stage where businesses attract and educate potential buyers before they enter the sales process.
Fill your pipeline with qualified interest. MarketJoy helps businesses build TOFU strategies that generate awareness and new opportunities.
